_comment: Which model runs each stage of /drive's ladder, by role. `stages` is keyed by the command each stage runs, with a `default` row for the rest; `roles` maps each role to an identifier per harness — `host` is the model running /drive itself, null is no identifier mapped yet. Edit the roles for your harness, by hand or with `python3 delivery/scripts/agents/models.py --set claude.fast=haiku`, at any time: /drive reads this before every stage. `make models` shows what results, `make check-agents` checks the shape. A harness with no row here cannot choose a model for a sub-task (delivery/scripts/agents/registry.json, `subagentModel`) and runs every stage on the host model. delivery/docs/agent-harnesses.md says more.
